input_driver: Computer Use sky.press_key / sky.click in the real installed Notepad process; synthetic OS keyboard and mouse input, not physical keyboard acceptance
profile_selection: User selected 音元拼音 before testing; the current installed product DLL was independently observed in PID 29208 before input
mode_scope: Current active profile mode; no mode change or real user settings read. This is not three-mode live-app acceptance.
observation_method: Native screenshots inspected after each input action. Notepad accessibility text was unavailable. Screenshot metadata captured_at records archive time after capture, not a precise input-event timestamp.

display_finding.observed: Candidate code annotations displayed ellipses, for example 2j... for a 2jru candidate, despite free screen space
display_finding.source_evidence: CandidateListUIElement.cpp:54-65 retains complete codes; CandidatePopup.cpp:274-311 measures full rows; ContractTests.cpp:963-970 requires long annotations to widen the popup; CandidatePopup.cpp:425-427 uses DT_END_ELLIPSIS
display_finding.hypothesis_not_proven: WS_BORDER width is not visibly added to the measured outer-window width; a client-area width mismatch may clip the longest row. No actual window geometry was measured in this run.
display_finding.scope: The drawing code predates ARM work. This run does not establish an ARM-specific defect or an intentional compact-display policy.

automation_limitations: Attempting to activate the previously minimized Explorer window returned a stale user-input observation error; refreshing it returned a minimized-window error. A new Explorer window was used successfully. This is not counted as a product focus-loss failure.
Initial packaged Notepad launch did not immediately yield a targetable window; list_windows identified the actual MSIX window. Screenshots were verified as Notepad before every test input.
